stem: Which line from the play signals a shift in Sophia’s attitude?

options.label: A
options.text: SOPHIA: [Puts down her binoculars.] What did he say? I couldn’t make out that last part. (line 7)

options.label: B
options.text: [Sophia turns to see what Allen is talking about, but the whale has already slipped below the surface.] (line 18)

options.label: C
options.text: SOPHIA: [Continues.] In fact, she had a calf not too long ago. I wonder if we’ll get to see her baby too. (line 25)

options.label: D
options.text: [Sophia stays silent and watches, awestruck and emotional.] (line 34)
